english:
Tone 4 [Dzd] "Those who are planted" (Ork tnkakitsk) and "Our Lord ascended into heaven" (Hambartsav tern mer yerkin). Dismissal Gospel: Mark 10:45 "For even the Son of Man..." to 11:11 "...with the twelve."

Monday. Morning Hymn: Tone 2 [Bk] "Pharaoh" (Pharavon). Patristic Canon [Harst]: Tone 8 [Dk] "Who the almighty" (Or zamenazor). Morning Gospel: Luke 20:1 "One day, as [Jesus] was teaching..." to verse 8 "...I do these things." Midday Hymn [Chashu]: Tone 1 [Ad] "He who ascended" (Or hambartsavn). Psalm 130 [131] "Lord, my heart is not..." [and] Psalm 131 [132] "Remember, Lord..." [and] Psalm 132 [133] "How good..." Acts 24:1 "Five days later..." to verse 20 "...he was speaking with him." Psalm 46:5 [47:5] "God has ascended..." Catholic Epistle: 2 John 1:1 "The elder..." to verse 13 "...grace be with you." Alleluia. Psalm 23 [24] "Lift up [your heads]..." Gospel: John 12:24 "Truly, truly, I say to you..." to verse 26 "...my Father."
In the Evening: First Gospel: Matthew 21:18 "Early in the morning..." to verse 32 "...believe him." Mesedi: "Sing to the Lord..." [and] "Enter before him." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi]: Tone 3 [Gdz] "Those who are planted" (Ork tnkakitsk) and "Our Lord Jesus Christ ascended." Dismissal Gospel: Mark 11:12 "On the following day..." to verse 26 "...your trespasses."

Tuesday. Morning Hymn: Tone 3 [Gdz] "Helper" (Ognakan). Patristic Canon [Harst]: Tone 8 [Dk] "Today they rejoice" (Aysor tsndan). Morning Gospel: Luke 20:9 "He began to tell..." to verse 19 "...this parable." Midday Hymn [Chashu]: Tone 8 [Dk] "Who by mercy" (Or voghormutyamp). Psalm 134 [135] "Praise the Lord..." [and] Psalm 135 [136] "Give thanks..." Acts 24:27 "But when two years..." to 25:12 "...to Caesar you shall go." Psalm 46:5 [47:5] "God has ascended..." Catholic Epistle: 3 John 1:1 "The elder to the beloved Gaius..." to verse 15 "...by name." Alleluia. Psalm 23 [24] "Lift up [your heads]..." Gospel: John 12:27 "Now is my soul..." to verse 43 "...the glory of God."
In the Evening: First Gospel: Matthew 21:33 "Listen to another parable..." to verse 46 "...they held him." Mesedi: "Come and see..." [and] "Our God." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi]: Tone 4 [Dzd] "Those who are planted" (Ork tnkakitsk) and "Our Lord ascended into heaven." Dismissal Gospel: Mark 11:27 "They came again..." to 12:17 "...and they marveled at him."

Wednesday. Morning Hymn: Tone 6 [Gk] "Sing to the Lord" (Yergetsek teandn). Patristic Canon [Harst]: Tone 8 [Dk] "Glorified is" (Paravoryal e). Morning Gospel: Luke 20:20 "So they watched him..." to verse 26 "...they were silent." Midday Hymn [Chashu]: Tone 3 [Gdz] "Principalities" (Ishkhanutyunk). Psalm 136 [137] "By the rivers..." [and] Psalm 138 [139] "O Lord, you have searched me..." Acts 25:13 "And after some days..." to verse 22 "...tomorrow you shall hear." Psalm 46:5 [47:5] "God has ascended..." Catholic Epistle: Jude 1:1 "Jude, a servant of Jesus..." to verse 7 "...undergoing a punishment." Alleluia. Psalm 23 [24] "Lift up [your heads]..." Gospel: John 12:44 "Then Jesus cried out..." to verse 50 "...so I speak."
In the Evening: First Gospel: Matthew 22:1 "And again Jesus spoke..." to verse 14 "...chosen." Mesedi: "Our God is in heaven..." [and] "At the departure." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi]: Tone 3 [Gdz] "Those who are planted" (Ork tnkakitsk) and "Our Lord Jesus Christ ascended." Dismissal Gospel: Mark 12:18 "Then some Sadducees came..." to verse 31 "...to ask him."
[AZAZ - abbreviation for fast days]
Thursday. Morning Hymn: Tone 4 [Dzd] "Let us bless the Lord" (Orhnesguk eztet). Patristic Canon [Harst]: Tone 8 [Dk] "Who from the beginning" (Or yarach). Morning Gospel: Luke 20:28 "Some of the Sadducees came..." to 21:4 "...all she had to live on." Midday Hymn [Chashu]: Tone 1 [Ad] "He who ascended" (Or hambartsavn). Psalm 139 [140] "Deliver me..." [and] Psalm 140 [141] "I call upon you..." [and] Psalm 141 [142] "With my voice..." Acts 25:23 "So on the next day..." to 26:32 "...appealed to Caesar." Catholic Epistle: Jude 1:8 "Yet in like manner..." to verse 15 "...sinners and ungodly." Alleluia. Psalm 23 [24] "Lift up [your heads]..." Gospel: John 13:1 "Now before the Feast..." to verse 15 "...you also should do."
In the Evening: First Gospel: Matthew 22:15 "Then the Pharisees went..." to verse 46 "...and no one." Mesedi: "Let it be..." [and] "Give ear, O Shepherd." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi]: Tone 4 [Dzd] "Those who are planted" (Ork tnkakitsk) and "Our Lord ascended into heaven." Dismissal Gospel: Mark 12:35 "And as Jesus taught..." to verse 44 "...all she had to live on."

Friday. Morning Hymn: Tone 8 [Dk] "Victorious" (Haghtakan). Patristic Canon [Harst]: Tone 8 [Dk] "Unoriginate Word" (Anskizpn band). Morning Gospel: Luke 21:5 "And while some were speaking..." to verse 38 "...to hear him." Midday Hymn [Chashu]: Tone 8 [Dk] "Who by mercy" (Or voghormutyamp). Psalm 142 [143] "Hear my prayer, O Lord..." [and] Psalm 143 [144] "Blessed be the Lord..." [and] Psalm 144 [145] "I will extol you..." Acts 27:1 "And when it was decided..." to 28:16 "...with the soldier who guarded him."
